title: Structural Risk vs Managed Risk: How to Trade Bigger
text: The purpose of differentiating structural risk from managed risk is because you can trade more. If I'm putting on something and I'm simply going to take it at the structural risk level, what this is showing you is if each one is 1820 per contract and I'm willing to risk about 5800 bucks, I can trade three of these. But if I know I'm going to manage these on average at say 480 per contract, that means for that same risk, because there's a management element to it, I can trade a bigger size. Now, remember, you can't just use that as a way to trade more size. You have to pick the way you manage it in a way that makes sense for your strategy.
